articleTitle: Aero-Engines Remaining Useful Life Prognostics Based on Multi-Hierarchical Gated Recurrent Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: To address the problem that most deep learning-based aero-engine RUL prediction models only consider temporal feature extraction and ignore spatial feature extraction, GCN is introduced into LSTM, and the network information is layered by designing the main oblivious gate and the main input gate. The spatial features embedded in the sensor data species are processed using GCN, whereas the LSTM deals with features with apparent temporal trends. The hybrid layer simultaneously performs the extraction of spatio-temporal information in multi-sensor data is extracted. Finally, the quantile regression layer is utilized for RUL prediction and uncertainty quantification. The experimental results show that MHGRGCN can efficiently fuse the modeling process of temporal and spatial correlation to extract more accurate state degradation features for RUL prediction.

Author Keywords: Multi-hierarchical gated recurrent graph convolutional network

articleTitle: Local Variance-driven Level Set Model with Application to Segment Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The development of computer vision and medical treatment has driven the development of the medical image. At the same time, as one of the key technologies of medical image postprocessing, the accuracy and robustness of medical image segmentation play a key role in assisting doctors in diagnosis and treatment. In this study, we propose the local variance-driven level set model, which combines the local variance difference and the boundary information dynamically for segmenting medical images. The local variance difference is introduced into the area term to control the role of the area term in the overall energy functional and optimize the ability to resist noise. The edge detection function of is added to detect the edge of organs or lesions more accurately. The application to medical images shows that our local variance-driven level set model is more effective for medical image segmentation. Compared with other level set methods, the local variance-driven level set model is more accurate and more robust to noise.

articleTitle: Modeling and I-NSGA-III Solution of Allocation Problem in Echelon Usage of Dual-Life Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Analyze the allocation problem between equipment user units and backup warehouses in the echelon usage of dual-life equipment. A decision model for the allocation problem was constructed, and optimization objectives were proposed in terms of average reserve priority difference, number of allocation, and quantity of life waste. An improved fast non dominated sorting genetic algorithm based on reference points was used to solve the problem. We are adopting segmented natural number encoding and an adaptive mutation operator in our algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can improve convergence speed and obtain batter search results on this problem, verifying the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Class-specific attribute reduction based on neighborhood conditional entropy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Traditional attribute reduction techniques treat all classes equally, potentially overlooking the unique requirements and characteristics of specific classes. To overcome this limitation, we introduce neighborhood conditional entropy to propose a method of class-specific attribute reduction in a neighborhood decision table (NDT). In this work, we first define the neighborhood conditional entropy for the specific class, along with the corresponding attribute reduction conditions and relevant properties. Furthermore, we define the concept of attribute significance degree and propose the class-specific attribute reduction algorithm based on neighborhood conditional entropy (NCECAR). This algorithm aims to acquire the reduction of the most informative and discriminative attributes that significantly contribute to the classification accuracy of the specific class. Finally, experiments and analysis for diverse datasets demonstrate the proposed method’s superiority in classification performance for the specific class.

articleTitle: Multi-level Similarity Complementary Fusion for Unsupervised Cross-Modal Hashing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Cross-modal hashing is widely used in multimedia retrieval tasks for its advantages of low storage cost and high retrieval speed. In recent years, many deep unsupervised cross-modal hashing methods were proposed to deal with unlabeled data. These methods usually generate a similarity matrix from raw features as a guidance signal for model training. However, this type of techniques introduce bias in feature measurements as they fail to accurately capture semantic relationships between cross-modal data to eliminate the error caused by the original features. Furthermore, the multiple semantic correlations between instances are underutilized, which makes it difficult to narrow the semantic gap. To address these issues, we propose a novel multi-level similarity complementary fusion (MSCF) method. Specifically, we fuse similarity matrices from different modalities. After feature interaction and reconstruction, we perform multilevel complementary fusion with the similarity in the common Hamming space to form the final instance similarity matrix, which is used to guide the model training. We conduct extensive experiments to verify the improvement of our work over existing works.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Image Detection Method in Urban Low-altitude Complex Background
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the rapid development of urban air traffic, more and more Unmanned Aerial Vehicles are appearing in cities. The government focuses on the need for safety-oriented unmanned aviation to strengthen the regulatory capability, and to form cooperative air-ground object active surveillance, as well as passive object surveillance supplemented by visible light detection. The Unmanned Aerial Vehicle detection method for urban low-altitude complex backgrounds based on YOLOv7x is proposed and to ensure the safety of flight activities. We construct an experimental dataset which is called UAVULCB (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle dataset used in Urban Low-altitude Complex Background). Extensive experiments on the UAV-ULCB validate that this method achieves 95.8% mAP50 with an inference speed of 30 frames/second. Finally, the heat map by the Grad-CAM is used to show the most concerned parts and increase the interpretability of the model. This method provides a strong technical support for urban air traffic supervisory authorities, which can be safeguarded the safety of urban Unmanned Aerial Vehicle flight activities together with other supervisory methods.

articleTitle: A Data-driven Neural Network Used on Maneuvering Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Maneuvering target tracking is a key issue in the field of target tracking. The target tracking based on the motion model is hard to accurately predict and track maneuvering target. This article design a data-driven neural network to complete the maneuvering target tracking. A maneuver trajectory generator and trajectory mapper are designed to generate enough trajectory sample, providing data-driven support for training the neural network. The DTN network was trained based on the trajectory sample and the trained DTN network is able to effectively track the maneuvering target. Simulation result demonstrates that the DTN has high accuracy and efficiency than the traditional model prediction method on maneuvering target tracking.

articleTitle: A Local Expansion and Community Merging Based Algorithm for Community Detection in Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Community detection is an important issue in studying network structure and network characteristics. It has received widespread attention in many fields. Most existing community detection algorithms obtain the final community structure by analyzing the relationship between each node and surrounding nodes. Starting from a portion of nodes in each community, the corresponding community for each node can be obtained through expansion operations, thereby obtaining the entire community structure. Such strategy can improve the accuracy of community detection algorithms. In this study, we propose a local expansion and community merging (LECM) based algorithm. The LECM consists of four main parts. Firstly it chooses important nodes. In the second step, based on local modularity, important nodes are locally expanded to obtain local communities. Next, the merging degree standard is used to determine and merge local communities. Finally, the boundary overlapping nodes are reprocessed to ensure the accuracy of the community partition results. Several tests on five synthetic and two real-world networks are set to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, the experimental result shows that LECM has better performance than two existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Structure learning of Bayesian network based on firefly hybrid optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Aiming at the low learning efficiency and easy to fall into local optimization of Bayesian network structure learning algorithm, a hybrid optimization algorithm of fireflies (MIC-FA) is proposed. Firstly, the undirected graph containing most correct edges is obtained by the maximum information coefficient, so as to generate the initial population of MIC-FA algorithm. Then, the position of firefly individual is updated by directional movement, random movement and mutation operation in firefly optimization algorithm. Finally, the firefly with the highest Bayesian information criterion score is the best Bayesian network structure. Experimental results show that, compared with the contrast algorithm, the accuracy and optimization efficiency of the proposed algorithm are improved.

articleTitle: Quality Problem Group and Its Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In order to explore the scientific nature behind quality problem in engineering manufacturing industry, the research ideology of quality problem group was put forward, and the internal mechanism of quality problem group was analyzed, and the discrete dynamic model of quality problem group was established. At last, it was found that the quality problem group followed the mixed motion law composed of linear system and bilinear system.

articleTitle: A Compound Generative Adversarial Network Designed for Stock Price Prediction Based on WGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In the stock market, the combination of historical stock data and machine learning methods has gradually replaced the investment method that relies solely on human experience. We have implemented a composite Generative Adversarial Network based on a pre-training model, which deeply analyzes the characteristics of stock trends and is more suitable for processing stock data than traditional methods. The models introduced in this manuscript including pre-training model and deep training model. The deep training model also includes the Generative Adversarial Network, ARIMA-Lasso units, and selectors. When dealing with the historical data set of American stock market in recent 3 years, we find that the optimal accuracy of our model is more than 84% in all experiments. In addition, we also compared this model with other excellent models, which also proved that this model is outstanding.

articleTitle: Optimal Guidance Law Considering Coupled Orbit-Attitude for Space Target
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Space debris seriously threaten the safety of artificial spacecraft in orbit. To achieve the rapidity of space debris capturing and removal, an optimal guidance law considering coupled orbit-attitude for space non-cooperative target is proposed. Firstly, a relative kinematics model of the spacecraft and the target is constructed, and a coupling control strategy based on time-division multiplexing theory is designed. Then, the optimal guidance law with minimum energy consumption as the cost function is designed, and the acceleration command is adjusted through vector decomposition to reduce the impact of velocity leading angle on the deviation accuracy. Finally, the designed guidance law is simulated and verified in the case of thrust attenuation error, and compared with proportional guidance law. The results show that the proposed optimal guidance law can reduce energy consumption by 56.9% while satisfying the guidance accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on human pose estimation algorithm for occlusion scene
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes a human pose estimation algorithm for obscured scenes with poor prediction results caused by self or external objects. Firstly, a lightweight upsampling operator CARAFE is introduced to optimize the traditional nearest neighbor interpolation to reduce the localization error caused by interpolation and thus improve the localization accuracy of key points. Secondly, by building an improved multiscale feature fusion module WASP, the network can fully utilize and fuse different resolution features to ensure the adequacy of feature information. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy AP of this algorithm can reach 76.7 %, which is 0.8 % higher than the original algorithm, and effectively improves the performance of human key point detection in occlusion scenes.

articleTitle: Research on the Quality Analysis of Law Enforcement Personnel Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In the context of China’s implementation of the strategy of governing the country by law, law enforcement personnel, as the main body of law enforcement departments in implementing legal actions, their ability and quality are related to the fairness and efficiency of law enforcement, and affect the entire law enforcement team. This article uses the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to analyze the ability and quality of law enforcement personnel. From the aspects of professional skills, personal abilities, thinking and decision-making, find the factors that determine the ability and quality of law enforcement personnel, and plays an important reference role in strengthening the cultivation of high-quality professional law enforcement teams.

articleTitle: Multi UAV Cooperative Reconnaissance Based on Dynamic Programming IDQN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In this paper, multiple UAV cooperative reconnaissance tasks in complex environments are realized based on deep reinforcement learning. With the goal of quickly completing reconnaissance task allocation, safely avoiding obstacles and finally completing flight tasks, task allocation and trajectory planning are tightly coupled, and a multiple UAV cooperative reconnaissance algorithm based on dynamic programming multi-agent independent deep Q networks (IDQN) is proposed, Implemented collaborative reconnaissance task allocation and trajectory planning flight decision-making for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles in complex environments, and completed collaborative reconnaissance tasks for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles.

articleTitle: Stochastic Dual-Channel Supply Chain with Low Carbon Preference and Carbon Emission Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The optimal solution for one stochastic dual-channel supply chain based on consumer low-carbon preferences and cap-and-trade system is considered in this paper. Compared with single traditional retail channel, whether the manufacturer should open online direct channel is discussed on account of the expected profit of manufacturer. By using backward derivation in Stackelberg game model, the optimal solutions are derived both under decentralized model and centralized model. The effects of critical parameters on optimal solutions are analyzed through theoretical deduction. Finally, the comparative analysis is carried out by numerical results.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation of lightweight unmanned aerial vehicles in sea scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The existing semantic segmentation algorithms are mainly applied to road scenes, while in the sea special situations such as the long-range strip shape of ships, blurred boundaries of the area to be segmented, and wind and wave disturbances can not be ignored. In addition, the computing power and data storage memory space of drone onboard systems are limited. Traditional semantic segmentation algorithms have certain limitations and can not meet the requirements of drone semantic segmentation for scenes in the sea: lightweight, real time and accuracy. This paper is based on the junior framework of DeepLabV3+ and proposes a lightweight unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) semantic segmentation of sea scenes-light Multi-scale attention model(LSMA) which features parallel multi-scale attention feature fusion. The segmentation not only achieves the goal of real-time and accuracy of image processing but also ensures the overall lightweight of the model. Firstly, the optimized MobileNetV2 is used in the backbone network, greatly reducing the number of network parameters. Secondly, a lightweight channel and location attention mechanism are introduced to process the deep semantic features transmitted from the backbone network in parallel with the hollow convolutionn space pyramid module in order to improve the network’s ability to segment the boundary between the sea target and the sea surface with similar features. The experimental results show that compared to traditional neural networks, the proposed network can significantly reduce the number of network parameters and system overhead while ensuring high-precision image segmentation. This model on the updated Vocdevkit dataset achieves a MIoU of SO.73%, mPA of 90.44%, and accuracy of 94.68%. The processing time for a single 512x512 image is only 225ms, 43.75% higher than that of traditional networks.

articleTitle: Confrontation Simulation Platform Based on Spatio-temporal Agents
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The deep spatio-temporal data model network structure is mainly used in research fields that contain a large amount of spatio-temporal data. Currently, the typical application example is traffic management. However, a large amount of spatio-temporal data can also be generated in military confrontation fields.Traditional military confrontation simulation platforms mainly study the operating mechanism inside weapon systems, set certain command strategies and communication rules, simplify time and space factors, focus on improving the intelligence of combat groups, and lack attention to regular patterns and intelligence in time and space dimensions of individuals. An appropriate deep spatio-temporal data model network structure can be used to fully utilize the spatial and temporal factors, discover more intelligent expression patterns of complex confrontational individuals in military confrontation, improve the autonomous ability of combat individuals, and better serve future intelligent warfare.This paper establishes multi-spatio-temporal agent confrontation simulation platform based on the deep spatiotemporal data model and military simulation applications. First, the requirements of the military confrontation simulation platform are analyzed. Then, specific task scenarios are given to simulate the behavior of all independent spatio-temporal agents in the entire military confrontation. This provides a reference for commanders to make effective decisions.

articleTitle: Adversarial learning based intra-modal classifier for cross-modal hashing retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Cross-modal hashing is popular for its high efficiency, low dimensionality, low storage overhead in information retrieval, and its ability to effectively characterize the consistency of high-level features of multi-source heterogeneous data. In this article, we present a fresh method that utilizes an intra-modal classifier that employs discrimination loss to learn intra-modal discriminations based on classification targets of image-text pairs. Meanwhile, the modality classifier serves as the discriminator in a GAN framework, using adversarial loss to reduce heterogeneity between different modality representations. To measure the efficiency of our method, we evaluate our proposed approaches against 8 other methods on three public benchmark datasets and show that our approaches outperform them in both I2T and T2I query.

articleTitle: A Dual-Branch Network Based on Transformer and Depthwise Convolution for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In the past few years, the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) has become prevalent in hyperspectral image (HSI) classification research. However, since the convolutional operation of the CNN is performed on the local space, it is difficult to deal with the spectral global dependency of HSIs. Moreover, because of the small perceptual field of the CNN, it is often necessary to design a very deep network, which limits its classification performance and classification efficiency. To tackle the mentioned challenges, this paper proposes a dual-branch network based on transformer and depthwise convolution for HSI classification (DBTD). DBTD employs a dual-branch end-to-end classification model based on transformer and depthwise convolution that adaptively extracts spectral features of HSIs using an attention mechanism on the main branch, and captures the long-distance dependency between features at a global scale. It uses the other depthwise convolutional branch to extract spatial neighborhood features that assists in classification. According to the experimental findings, the proposed approach outperforms the compared methods across various public datasets, demonstrating its feasibility and effectiveness in HSI classification.

articleTitle: Analysis of Upward Transmission Characteristics of Blue-Green Lasers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: To study the transmission characteristics of blue-green lasers through the ocean-atmosphere interface, the effects of wind speed on light transmission were analyzed using the RH-G scattering phase function. Monte Carlo method, refraction law, and Mie theory were utilized to simulate the light field distribution and attenuation of blue-green lasers passing through the ocean-atmosphere interface, taking into account the influence of wind speed on the ocean surface wave height. The results showed that as the wind speed increased, the light distribution became more dispersed and the light intensity attenuation became more severe. Moreover, at a constant wind speed, an increase in transmission distance led to a more divergent light distribution and greater attenuation of light intensity.

articleTitle: Target Combat Intention Recognition Based on Improved Fisher Information Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Recognizing the opponent’s intention is an important part in situational assessment and make the operation decision. Based on the pattern recognition technology of artificial intelligence, a combat intention recognition algorithm according to the value of Fisher information matrix is proposed. The target’s combat intention knowledge rule base is constructed and the relative Fisher information matrix is designed to evaluate the target’s current state information. The target combat intention recognition problem is transformed into an optimization problem according to the Fisher information matrix. The contribution index is defined to eliminate redundant information during the discrimination process, which improves the accuracy and efficiency of the target combat intention recognition. The proposed algorithm is used on multi-target combat intention recognition and the simulation results verified that the proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: A belief rule-based fault diagnosis method for Multi-UAVs under missing attribute data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: To reasonably improve the missing attribute data and effectively integrate sample data and uncertain expert knowledge, this paper proposes a new fault diagnosis method based on a belief rule base (BRB). In the case of missing attribute data, the maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) method is used to complete the missing attribute data, and the fault diagnosis method of the multi-UAVs is constructed by using other complete attribute data as the input information of BRB. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experimental simulation.

articleTitle: Modified particle filter based on feature extraction coupling for track-before-detect algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: For traditional particle filter track-before-detect(TBD) algorithms, when tracking targets, these algorithms require inter frame accumulation of multiple frames to accurately achieve target tracking. In this paper, we modify the traditional particle filter TBD by adding the feature extraction, in which the feature extract is used to classify the target scope and clutter scope before target tracking to narrow down the scope of particle generation. The simulation results show that the modified particle filter algorithm has significantly modified tracking performance compared to traditional particle filter algorithms, and has engineering application value.

articleTitle: Research on Power Cable Material Full Chain Tracking Management System Based on RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Power cable is an important material component of power enterprises. Some technical difficulties exist in the operation and maintenance of cable materials, such as high labor intensity, security risks, low work efficiency in current cable material management. The cable is easy to get wet and manual recording efficiency of cable detection data is low. In order to improve the automation degree and data entry accuracy of cable material management process, this paper proposes an RFID Identification method with cable cross section cold shrinkage sealing device. and designs a power cable material tracking management system based on Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology. A cold shrinkage sealing device for cable cross section with moisture-proof and RFID identification functions is made, which provides RFID identification information for power cable material tracking management system. It realizes the functions of automatic storage management, storage management and inventory management of cable. The system can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of cable material management, and further realize the intellectualization of material management.

articleTitle: Deep CNN with Dense and Many-to-Many Connections for Image Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The deep convolution neural network (CNN) has attracted continually increasing attention in the field of machine learning. The deep CNN is applied in image super-resolution (SR) fields and has obtained good performance. This paper proposes a new deep CNN model (SR2DCNN) with dense and many-to-many connections to reconstruct the SR image. Our model uses a deep CNN with DenseNet and many-to-many connections, which makes it faster and performs well. This structure efficiently addresses the issue of gradient disappearance while greatly reducing the number of parameters. In addition, we research the preprocessing and chose a more effective method. The proposed model can improve the applicability of the algorithm and reduce the requirements of the operating environment drastically. Specifically, the qualities of SR image can be improved by the SR2DCNN. Finally, extensive simulation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of SR2DCNN

articleTitle: Incorporating Path Constraints into Bayesian network under the Sparse Parent Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: When a Bayesian network (BN) is used to model a practical problem, sufficient prior knowledge is required, which is in the form of path constraints. Dynamic programming (DP) approach is one of the exact algorithms that is used for structure learning of BNs by optimizing a decomposable score function. In this study, we attempt to provide an efficient and compact method for incorporating the path constraints in DP with the guidance of sparse parent graph (SPG) and drive algorithms, which is used to obtain the optimal BN satisfying the given constraints. We use a rigorous deduction theory to provide useful insights on the implementation of path constraints in the DP algorithm. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach reduces the time and space complexities significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Multiple Loitering Munitions Trajectory Planning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Cooperative trajectory planning technology for multiple loitering munitions can significantly enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness, providing a significant strategic advantage in modern warfare. To meet the requirements of feasibility, stealth, and cooperation for multiple loitering munitions trajectories, this paper proposes a cooperative trajectory planning method based on the hybrid algorithm of tent chaos artificial bee colony and particle swarm optimization(TCM-ABC-PSO). The proposed method establishes a model consisting of a single loitering munition planning layer and a multiple loitering munitions cooperative planning layer. The initial population is initialized using tent chaos mapping. By combining recombination operators and selection probabilities from both ABC and PSO algorithms, information exchange between them is facilitated to compensate for their respective shortcomings. This enables the algorithm to possess excellent global and local search capabilities. The application of TCMABC-PSO in solving the loitering munition trajectory planning model is demonstrated in this paper. Simulation results indicate that TCM-ABC-PSO exhibits superior optimization performance and convergence efficiency. It enables the planning of cooperative trajectories that satisfy the maneuverability constraints of loitering munitions, while also ensuring diverse attack angles for increased target destruction probability.

articleTitle: Research on Operation State Evaluation of Power Plant Key Transformer Equipment Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: A multiple criteria decision making model of ordinary oil-immersed transformers replacement priority with high overload capacity distribution transformers (HOCDT) in self-use power system of thermal power plant is proposed in this paper. The decision making model consists of device property assessment and health condition assessment. The details of various assessment methods include device property assessment based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and health condition assessment method based on fuzzy synthetic evaluation. Integrating the device property assessment results and the health condition assessment results, we get a more comprehensive priority assessment result. An actual self-use power system of thermal power plant is utilized to validate the model and the numerical results testify that: the assessment model considering multiple aspects related to this problem could give a more comprehensive assessment result than just considering one of them and an appropriate priority scheme of transformers replacement obtained. The research in this paper could provide a feasible reference for self-use power system of thermal power plant to prioritize the replacement of ordinary distribution transformers.

articleTitle: In-Vehicle Acoustic Event Detection Model Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The trend towards intelligence is prominent in the modern automobile industry, leading to a continuous increase in vehicle computing power. The incorporation of artificial intelligence into the vehicle cabin is expected to significantly enhance user experience. Sound, as a medium, holds the potential to offer a plethora of valuable vehicular information. Prompt identification of anomalous sounds within the vehicle can preemptively identify potential safety risks and contribute to overall vehicular safety. In this study, we propose a neural network-based approach to monitor certain irregular events within the vehicle. The model training utilized recorded in-car data. The dataset content encompasses various abnormal sound, including knocking sounds, pet vocalizations, etc. Additionally, data augmentation was performed using the log-Mel spectrogram transform and SpecAugment method. The model classifies them through a neural network, and the mixup method was utilized. We used three models, all of which are desgined based on convolutional neural network architecture. In the result, the structure of Deep Space Separable Distillation Block reaches an accuracy of 99.66%.

articleTitle: A remaining useful life prediction method for gyroscope based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction plays a key role in assuring the safety and reliability of a practical system, and it can further reduce the maintenance cost caused by needless downtime or failure. Gyroscope is the key component in the missile, satellite carrier or space exploration rock, hence the performance of the gyroscope directly determines the accuracy of navigation and guidance. This paper presents a RUL prediction method for gyroscope on the basis of the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) method. The time-series drift rate data are first preprocessed to be the input-output form, and then the processed data are utilized to train a LSTM model. Once the LSTM model is trained, it can be used to predict the drift rate of gyroscope, and the according failure time and the RUL will be determined. The feasibility of the proposed drift rate together with the RUL prediction method is verified by the simulated gyroscope drift rate data.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Loss of Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on NMEA2000 Ship Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Unmanned Surface Vehicle(USV) has the ability to navigate autonomously, sense and explore, making them a new research hit.The energy usage rate of USV directly affects their own load capacity and operating time. The paper studies the effects of wind and wave currents and power electronic devices on the energy loss of USV. Based on the NMEA2000 protocol, a ship network is designed to connect the battery management system, anemoclinograph, water flow sensor, Global Positioning System (GPS) and Inertia Measurement Unit (IMU). The relationship between battery energy loss and wind, wave currents, power electronic devices is analyzed using multiple linear regression. The paper finally obtains that wind speed and wind direction have the most influence on the energy loss of USV and contributs to the research of USV ship network.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneous Sensor Deployment Method Based on Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In order to better cooperate between sensors in the complex and changeable battlefield environment, it is necessary to rationally deploy multi-source heterogeneous sensors. Various sensors serving weapon systems have different functions, powers, and precisions. Therefore, a sensor evaluation model is proposed to calculate the evaluation indicators of several commonly used sensors, aiming at the requirements of real-time perception and acquisition of information in the complex battlefield situation and the sensor’s own parameter performance. Subsequently, the sensor evaluation index combined with the coverage index, interference index, and other indicators is used as the optimization objective function to study the heterogeneous sensor deployment method based on the whale optimization algorithm. The objective is to achieve the sensor location deployment that meets the optimal index. The simulation results demonstrate that the whale optimization algorithm effectively avoids falling into local optima and enhances the utilization rate of sensor resources in the research of heterogeneous sensor deployment.

articleTitle: Research on the Generalization Ability of Reinforcement Transfer Learning Based on Self Game
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In order to improve the generalization ability of reinforcement learning algorithm, a transfer learning training method integrating self game is proposed. This method can enable both sides to jointly optimize a strategy, share the experience pool, and use the transfer learning algorithm to continuously migrate the trained model to a more complex air combat environment. Finally, the trained model can be applied to a variety of air combat environments. This method not only accelerates the training speed of the strategy, improves decision performance, but also makes the samples more diverse, allowing the decision model to learn more air combat knowledge and improve generalization ability.

articleTitle: Comparing the Effectiveness of PPO and its Variants in Training AI to Play Game
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Automated game intelligence is a crucial step in rapid game development. A promising research direction for automated game intelligence is reinforcement learning, and specifically, the proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm. Two variants of the PPO, Maskable PPO and Recurrent PPO, further extend the capabilities of the PPO. We compare the performance of these three algorithms in the 2D game Mario and a 3D car racing game environment. We also evaluate their performance and applicability by comparing the experimental results of the original algorithm authors. With our results, we provide recommendations on PPO configuration depending on the target game type, providing future developers with a benchmark to help them decide which algorithm is most applicable for their applications.

articleTitle: Evaluation of USVs’ Combat Capability Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of unmanned technology, unmanned equipment has been widely used in combat practice, and accurate evaluation of the combat capability of its equipment can guide the accurate use of equipment. And presently, there is a lack of research on the evaluation of the combat effectiveness of unmanned vehicles. From the point of view of confrontation between the two sides in the sea combat, this paper analyzed the critical factors that affect the operational capabilities of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) and built a comprehensive capability evaluation index system. The weights of each evaluation index were determined by using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and the impact factors of USVs completing sea combat missions were comprehensively analyzed. A model was constructed using the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method to solve and verify the evaluation. The results show that this method can effectively conduct quantitative evaluations of the operational capabilities of USVs, and can serve as a reference for subsequent equipment efficacy evaluations in sea combat.

articleTitle: Design of motion pattern recognition system based on artificial intelligence methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: This paper builds a wearable device that can be used for motion movement recognition based on artificial intelligence technology. Firstly, a human motion data collection device is designed to realise data collection and pre-processing; secondly, the collected data is classified based on artificial intelligence technology to realise pattern recognition of motion states; finally, the results of recognition are analysed and the results show that motion pattern recognition based on artificial intelligence methods is feasible.

articleTitle: Task Allocation for Space Debris Removal based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Space debris removal task allocation refers to the assignment of different tasks to different spacecraft, in order to achieve optimal utilization and combination of the spacecraft. To address the issue of traditional optimization algorithms easily falling into local optima in solving task allocation problems, this paper proposes a space debris removal task allocation method based on an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. In this method, the adaptability of inertia weight, learning factor, and social factor are used to reduce the randomness of particle position updates, thereby further improving the algorithm’s solving ability. Additionally, in order to deal with task allocation problems under multiple constraints, a penalty factor is introduced into the objective function to strengthen the punishment for the constraint conditions. Validation through simulation, the proposed method in solving the constrained space debris removal task allocation problem is 22.8% faster than the traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm, with a cost value reduction of 13.36%, and 40.07% faster and 5.64% lower cost value than the genetic algorithm. This method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of task allocation and has excellent stability. Therefore, this method has certain application prospects and promotion value in the task allocation problems in the field of aerospace.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control and Simulation Research on Dynamic Tensioning Force for Tracked vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Tracked vehicles have been widely used in transportation and military fields, and track tension mainly affects track reliability. Stable track tension can extend the service life of the track and improve the off-road performance of tracked vehicles. In order to maintain stable track tension during vehicle operation, we established a theoretical estimation model for track tension. The dynamic analysis of various components of the track tension device was conducted, and the theoretical calculation formula for track tension was derived. The theoretical calculation results were compared with the results of multi body dynamics simulation, verifying their consistency. On this basis, an active control system for track tension was designed based on fuzzy PID (proportional -integral derivative) control theory, using a co-simulation mode of RecurDyn and Matlab. It was found that the control system can quickly and accurately achieve the desired track tension. Compared with traditional track tensioning methods, the fuzzy PID control system can effectively reduce the dynamic track tension of the track in the contact area, and has a significant effect on suppressing the vibration of the vehicle body and the impact load of the track on the supporting roller, improving the stability of the tracked vehicle during driving.

articleTitle: Virtual-reality-based design and implementation with a parallel physical simulation platform for unmanned surface vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In order to reduce the problems of time-consuming, high cost as well as harsh sailing environment and unknown risks of the Unmanned Surface Vehicle(USV) in actual testing. This paper proposes a framework of USV visual simulation system based on virtual reality, focusing on simulation technologies such as experimental scene construction, simulation interactive communication, and USV motion simulation. Through the experimental, it is verified that the visual simulation system has good real-time and accuracy, and can simulate the real USV to realize the algorithm control to verify and improve the algorithm, which greatly improves the development efficiency of the USV.

articleTitle: YUCML-An usage control policy language for end-to-end data sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In today’s interconnected world, securely sharing data between devices and systems is crucial. End-to-end big data sharing enables seamless communication and collaboration, but also presents data security and control challenges. To ensure data confidentiality and integrity, data usage control is important. We designed a control policy language to provide a unified way to describe data usage control policies. The language can embed common scripting languages for policy description and can describe policy rules for various access control models like ABAC and RBAC, as well as data usage obligations and conditions. By separating the policy description model rules and embedding them in the data, only a small set of rules needs to be transmitted for data using the same policy model, without retransmit data usage policies. We implemented a policy engine on Linux. Experiments show its transmission and storage overhead is reduced by 90% compared to directly attaching XACML to data.

articleTitle: Multitask Multiobjective Optimization Method for Adaptive Band Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Band selection is a crucial issue in hyperspectral image analysis. Due to variations in the data characteristics of hyperspectral images, it is necessary to perform adaptive band selection for each specific image. Current adaptive band selection methods primarily focus on the information content, redundancy, and number of bands based on unlabeled samples. However, these methods overlook the fact that utilizing a small number of labeled samples can greatly aid in selecting highly discriminative band subsets. This paper proposes a multitask multiobjective optimization method that simultaneously utilizes the discriminatory power of labeled samples and the information from abundant unlabeled samples to adaptively select the most suitable band subset. One task evaluates the information and redundancy of the selected band subset using unlabeled samples, while the other task incorporates labeled samples to assess the number of bands and discrimination of the selected subset. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed adaptive band selection method effectively chooses the optimal band subset for a wide range of hyperspectral images, achieving high discrimination, information content, and low redundancy.

articleTitle: Class Imbalanced Semi-Supervised Learning With Meta-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In recent years, in order to solve the lack of labeled data faced by deep learning, semi-supervised learning (SSL) algorithms based on pseudo-label methods and consistency regularization methods have achieved remarkable results. These algorithms can achieve performance comparable to supervised learning with only a small amount of data labels, but they perform poorly on class-imbalanced datasets in practical applications. On the one hand, the class imbalance problem will cause the model classification to shift towards the majority class, and on the other hand, it will cause pseudo-labels noise generated by the SSL algorithm. These two challenges together harm the performance of these algorithms on class-imbalanced datasets. We propose a meta sample reweighting algorithm to simultaneously address the above two challenges. We introduce two meta networks to adaptively weight labeled and unlabeled data respectively, use meta-learning framework to learn the parameters of the meta networks, and propose a meta learning algorithm that alternately updates the parameters of the meta-network and the classifier network. Experiments prove that this method can effectively alleviate the performance degradation of state-of-the-art SSL algorithms affected by the class imbalance problem.

articleTitle: Research on Positioning System in Large Ship Cabins Based on Virtual Reality and UWB-IMU Fusion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In the complex indoor environment of ships, personnel position is difficult to know in real time. In this paper, an indoor positioning management system in large ship based on virtual reality and ultra-wide-band(UWB)/Inertial Measurement Unit(IMU) fusion algorithm has been studied. Unity 3d is used to build a virtual reality platform which receive UWB and IMU data in real time. The coordinates of people in ship are calculated based on Kalman filtering algorithm. The virtual reality system is used to identify non-line of sight (NLOS) area and to reduce error caused by NLOS environment. Personnel position coordinates and the trajectory are displayed in the virtual platform. The experimental results show that the average positioning error of the fusion algorithm is 0. 08m, which is about 40% higher than the positioning accuracy of the single positioning method of UWB.

articleTitle: Research on Servo System of Unmanned Amphibious Rescue Vehicle for Sudden Flood Based on Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: At present, there are some problems in controlling the servo system of Unmanned Amphibious Rescue Vehicle (UARV) with PID controller, such as low track tracking accuracy, poor control error, poor stability and safety performance. A servo control system of UARV based on BP neural network tuning PID controller is proposed and designed. The driving model of servo control system of UARV in sudden flood disaster is established. This model is used as the controlled object. BP neural network is used to learn the performance of servo control system of UARV. BP neural network is used to tune the PID controller. Gradient descent method is used to modify the weighting coefficient of the controller to realize the adaptive adjustment of the controller and control the UARV in sudden flood disasters. The experimental results show that the servo system of UARV based on BP neural network tuning PID controller effectively improves the trajectory tracking accuracy, has better flexibility, the vehicle runs smoothly, and the rescue personnel are safe because of unmanned driving.

articleTitle: End-to-End Speech Keyword Spotting System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The purpose of speech keyword spotting is to detect a set of predefined keywords from a continuous speech signal stream. Based on the research on end-to-end technologies in the field of deep learning, this paper designs and implements an end-to-end speech keyword spotting algorithm, which has a wide range of applications in various fields, such as smartphones and automobiles. The algorithm first trains an acoustic model based on a deep neural network, which receives the acoustic features and outputs the posterior probability of the wake-up word. Then, the posterior probability is smoothed to obtain the confidence score of the wake-up word. Through the above process, the traditional decoding process can be avoided effectively. In addition, this paper compares various neural network structures of acoustic model, such as the time-delay neural network (TDNN) and the factorized time-delay neural network (TDNN-F). Through comparative experiments by controlling variables, it is verified that the proposed end-to-end speech keyword spotting algorithm has competitive performance compared with the other popular technologies.

articleTitle: An Anomaly Detection Algorithm of QAR Based on Spatial-Temporal Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: QAR (Quick Access Recorder) data contains numerous quality flaws such as anomalies and missing data. It will cause significant problems for subsequent data mining, model training, and analysis if it is not detected. To address these issues, this paper investigates QAR-specific anomaly detection (AD) algorithms before presenting a three-stage QAR data AD algorithm based on QAR spatial-temporal correlation, which includes single parameter AD, parameter correlation analysis, and multi parameter AD. The SST (Singular Spectrum Transformation) is used in this process to analyze the correlation between parameters based on the change point rather than the change trend. Simultaneously, a double K-means clustering algorithm that can automatically select the hyper-parameters K is proposed, followed by a relatively complete empirical experiment. The methods investigated in this paper are implemented in Python code, and their feasibility and effectiveness are demonstrated through simulation analysis. The accuracy rate is increased by 54% when compared to existing literature methods.

articleTitle: Modeling and calculation of attack area for multiaircraft cooperative guidance1
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Aiming at the dual-aircraft cooperative attack mode, the situation threat model of the fighter under different conditions is evaluated, the survivability threat assessment model is constructed, the dual-aircraft handover time and position solution model is established, and based on the cooperative guidance process and situation threat model, the calculation method of cooperative guidance attack area is established and simulation analysis is carried out. The simulation results show that the cooperative guidance decision based on situation advantage can significantly improve the attack efficiency and expand the attack area under some conditions.

articleTitle: Human behavior data extension method for mine scene
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: At present, there is no dedicated large-scale video data set for the task of monitoring unsafe behavior in mine scenes. In this paper, the monitoring data set of miners’ unsafe behavior is built by ourselves. The data set is divided into extended group and real group. The extended group and the real group, the extended group of clear video samples from 18 public data sets, for each clear video in the extended group with a particle simulation mask, to achieve a similar dust masking effect as the mine scene. The real group comes from the site monitoring of mine operations. This paper uses the MCTN(Muti-scenic Cyclic Translation Network) to complete cross-scenario knowledge transfer, so as to verify the validity of the mine unsafe behavior monitoring dataset constructed in this paper.

articleTitle: OAM beam correction based on Gerchberg-saxton algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In this research, the impact of ocean turbulence on vortex beams is explored, leading to the diffusion and distortion of their orbital angular momentum. The paper introduces a novel approach without the need for a wavefront sensor or a Gaussian beam as a probe. Instead, the Gerchberg-Saxton (GS) phase recovery algorithm is employed to correct the distorted beam, aiming to reduce the dispersion of the vortex beam and enhance communication performance. The GS algorithm utilizes multiple iterations of the input light intensity distribution to obtain the pre-phase. By analyzing the changes in the orbital angular momentum spectrum before and after correction, the algorithm effectively restores the purity of the beam. Additionally, the orthogonal nature of different orbital angular momentum in the vortex beam enables easy achievement of the multiplexing function. Experimental results demonstrate the successful correction of distorted vortex beams using the GS algorithm. Through phase correction, this technique improves the beam’s utilization, enhances its robustness, and minimizes transmission errors.

articleTitle: An Informer-based Spatio-Temporal network for traffic flow forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Spatio-temporal data is one type of multivariate time series(MTS), which has strong time dependence and complex spatial correlation. Spatio-temporal data prediction requires mining the temporal-spatial relations implied in the data to obtain trends in the data as they change over time and space. Traffic flow is a typical class of spatio-temporal data, due to the complexity of the traffic road network, the high spatio-temporal correlation of road conditions, and the strong coupling of traffic information in time and space, which makes it much more difficult to mine the correlation of data from traffic flow. However, existing traffic flow forecasting methods often focus only on its temporal attributes leading to the loss of spatial information or can only effectively handle short-time data, To solve this problem, we propose a spatio-temporal data network, which uses Informer to process the masked spatio-temporal data to enhance its data mining capability, and subsequently using spatio-temporal graph neural network (STGNN)to complete the spatial data processing. In this way, we achieve effective processing of long-time data. Finally, after the experimental validation on public dataset, the forecasting error of the proposed model is reduced and the training speed is improved.

articleTitle: DynArt ChatGPT: a platform for the generation of dynamic non-traditional New Year paintings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In a modern, technology-driven society, the preservation and development of China’s Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) has encountered three major contradictions: economic development, technological renewal and cultural change, resulting in a lack of people to pass on the heritage, difficulties in innovation and inadequate protection. In order to promote and develop Chinese traditional art, we had a vision: can we combine the conversation function of ChatGPT with the traditional art of ICH? Based on this idea, we have built a system - DynaArt ChatGPT. DynaArt ChatGPT can extract the keywords from the sample given by ChatGPT and then generate a description related to the sample based on the keywords, we input the description into Lumen5 model, Lumen5 will generate the corresponding dynamic video according to the description we input, after the experiment we think the dynamic painting generation After experiments we believe that the system can provide a new interpretation of some familiar Chinese folk tales.

articleTitle: Course relevance analysis based on Word Mover’s Distance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the progress of the times and the development of technology, the creation of artificial intelligence technology has brought a huge impact on the field of education. For the field of education, exploring curriculum relevance is one of its core elements. However, most of the traditional course relevance analysis is conducted from the perspective of course performance, ignoring the external factors that affect the performance such as test difficulty and student level. Since course text descriptions can describe a course more objectively than grades, it is necessary to apply text similarity analysis to course relevance research. The prevalent text similarity analysis is only achieved by word frequency statistics, ignoring the connection between textual contexts. In this context, this paper utilizes the Word Mover’s Distance (WMD) approach to analyze the relevance of course texts. The experimental results show the heat map of course relevance and demonstrate the superiority and effectiveness of the WMD method through the experimental comparison with the traditional text distance metric algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on channel modeling method of underwater optical communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Underwater optical communication technology is increasingly developing, and modeling of underwater visible light channels is also important. Seawater has complex components, and the effects of absorption, scattering, and turbulence jointly affect the quality of optical communication. We combine the channels established by the model-based analysis method and the numerical simulation method to form a comprehensive channel capable of analyzing the combined effects of three influencing factors. The combined channel model of the two methods enables us to analyze the influence of the three effects simultaneously.

articleTitle: Course Correlation Analysis using MLP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In the era of burgeoning AI technology and progressive educational systems, AI’s influence on education has become increasingly apparent. The intricacies between courses continue to intensify, heightening the need for researchers to conduct precise correlation analyses. Traditional practices, which rely solely on correlation coefficients, tend to focus on linear relationships between two courses, leaving much to be desired. To delve deeper into the relationships between multiple courses, a growing number of AI-assisted methodologies have emerged in the education arena. Consequently, we introduce the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) course relation approach, which scrutinizes the direct relationships embedded within grade data. Empirical evidence highlights the proposed MLP course correlation method’s capacity to reveal nonlinear and profound associations across multiple courses, showcasing its potential to revolutionize course correlation analysis.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of the Long Short Term Memory and Temporal Fusion Transformer Models on Regional Air Quality Forecast
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Real-time meteorological observation systems are of great importance in practical engineering use. Monitoring environmental data 24/7 not only provides a healthy and green living environment but also enables the prediction of future living conditions based on existing data, thus acting as a detection and warning. At this stage, weather monitoring stations usually use conventional detection, which often results in prediction deviations, thus bringing a more significant impact on weather detection in the whole region. Therefore, the prediction strategy of meteorological factors should be further strengthened and better defined. This study aims to fill this gap and compare the advantages and disadvantages of linear regression time series models, long and short-term memory models, and Temporal Fusion Transformer models theoretically and experimentally. Ultimately, we seek to provide researchers with information to aid them in choosing a prediction algorithm based on their available data volume.

articleTitle: Data Optimization Method for Ship Infrared Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: This study aims to address two challenging problems that affect the accurate and reliable recognition of ship infrared (IR) images in various scenarios: the interference of radiation highlights from specular reflections of target background sunlight and the difficulty of distinguishing ship targets from background confusion under low light conditions. We propose a data optimisation method for ship IR deep learning recognition, which uses processing tools such as median noise reduction and local histogram equalisation image enhancement to improve the performance and stability of ship IR recognition under the above unfavourable conditions. And the effectiveness of the method is verified on high fidelity mid-wave infrared (MWIR) ship simulation data using deep learning image classification algorithms such as AlexNet, VggNet and EfficientNet. To further demonstrate the effectiveness of the method, research has also adopted model feature gradient visualization technique, which indirectly verifies that our method can effectively improve the predictive reliability of ship recognition models. Overall, the data optimization method proposed in this study provides a feasible solution to address the challenges in ship IR image recognition and can provide a valuable reference for military mission-related research.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Steering Control for Dual Independent Electric Drive Tracked Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: An adaptive sliding mode steering control method is proposed for the problem of road surface uncertainty affecting the steering stability of electric drive tracked vehicle. The steering system is resolved into two subsystems: vehicle speed and steering angular speed. Firstly, the vehicle speed controller is designed by combining the extended state observer (ESO) and sliding mode control (SMC). Secondly, the steering angular speed controller is designed by combining the fuzzy logic system (FLS) and sliding mode control (SMC). The ESO and FLS estimate the longitudinal driving resistance and steering resistance moment of the vehicle that are difficult to measure. Substitute the estimated values into the control system to compensate for the influence of external uncertain disturbances and improve vehicle driving stability. The co-simulation results of Matlab+RecurDyn/HM show that the designed controller can achieve stable vehicle steering, effectively improving the speed tracking performance and anti-interference ability of tracked vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Flight Delay Propagation Prediction Method Based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In recent years, flight delay has become a problem that needs to be solved urgently. The problem of flight delay propagation prediction is studied in this thesis, which is the phenomenon of large area flight delay caused by an airport delay. The analysis and prediction of flight delay propagation in advance can assist civil aviation departments in controlling the flight delay rate and reducing the economic loss caused by flight delays. Firstly, the national flight data is cleaned and filtered to construct a dataset of flight chain affected by flight delay. At the same time, errors or missing values in the data are removed, and data related to flight delay are selected for subsequent analysis and modeling. Modeling analysis is performed on the issue of flight delay propagation, and a model of flight delay propagation is constructed to analyze the impact of flight delay propagation in airport network transmission. The model fully considers the interrelationship between flights, treating the flight chain as a whole rather than individual flights. This will be more conducive to exploring and understanding the causes and impacts of flight delay. Subsequently, in terms of constructing the dataset of flight chain structures, the method of data preprocessing and triplet flight chain dataset contains a series of flight chain data that can be used to predict the scope of flight delay propagation. Secondly, according to the features of flight delay, the Transformer model was adjusted and improved to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of prediction. The network architecture is restructured by injecting new convolutional pooling modules into the original network and adjusting the input and output dimensions of the network to make the overall model more tailored to flight delay prediction. Last but not least, the results of the experiments are showed that the modified model has low complexity, shorter time and good real-time performance. It makes prediction and decision faster, improves the real-time performance and better meets the needs of practical applications with an accuracy of 90.3%.

articleTitle: Comparison of LDPC codes based on CCSDS standard and 5G standard in underwater channels
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In the process of information transmission, in order to provide the system with certain error correction and anti-interference capabilities, the participation of channel coding is required. Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) codes, as a member of linear block codes, have been increasingly used in recent years. In order to adapt to different scenarios and address the main impacts during transmission, LDPC codes based on multiple standards have emerged, but no standards suitable for underwater channel transmission have emerged. In this article, in order to find more suitable LDPC codes for underwater channel transmission, LDPC codes based on two standards were selected. The underwater channel was simulated using a generalized gamma distribution model, and the same normalized minimum sum decoding method was used. Starting from two aspects of iteration times and normalization factors, this paper analyzes the error rate of LDPC codes based on the Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems (CCSDS) and the 5th Generation mobile communication systems (5G) standards in underwater channel transmission to determine the performance of these two LDPC codes. It was found that LDPC codes based on the CCSDS standard have significant advantages in low signal-to-noise ratio situations and have better performance in underwater channel transmission.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous UAV fleet delivery route: a novel discrete sheep flock migrate optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Completing the delivery task of rescue supplies with the fastest delivery time during natural disasters is very important. For emergency logistics delivery scenarios in complex terrain environments, drone delivery has gradually become a hot issue. We introduce an optimization of heterogeneous UAV delivery path in complex task scenarios. The proposed model aims to minimize the total delivery time of multiple drones, taking into account not only the impact of different types of drones’ endurance and load capacity on path selection, but also the timeliness of delivery tasks. To solve the proposed problem, we propose a novel discrete sheep flock migrate optimization (DSFMO) algorithm. As a type of swarm intelligence optimization algorithm, DSFMO algorithm has the characteristics of high efficiency, independent of mathematical models, and not easily trapped in local optima. In the case validation section, the case was designed based on the rescue scenario of the Sichuan earthquake, we analyzed and solved the problem model using the DSFMO algorithm, verified the effectiveness of the model and algorithm, and discussed different task scenarios and drone storage quantity. The experimental results indicate that, while ensuring the completion of disaster relief tasks and considering the load constraints of heterogeneous, the DSFMO algorithm can optimize the timeliness of drone delivery. This study can provide theoretical basis for drone logistics distribution in complex environments, and thus provide support and reference for drone path planning research.

articleTitle: Multi-Label Contrastive Semantics Preserving Based Cross-Modal Hashing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Thanks to the efficient storage and retrieval capabilities provided by hashing techniques, coupled with the highly discriminative feature extraction capabilities of deep neural networks, the field of deep cross-modal hashing has made significant progress in realizing efficient cross-modal retrieval tasks in recent years. Nonetheless, a majority of current supervised cross-modal hashing techniques typically rely on a solitary label to gauge the semantic similarity between cross-modal paired instances. This approach tends to overlook the fact that numerous cross-modal datasets encompass extensive semantic information across multiple labels. To solve this challenge, we propose a novel multi-label contrastive semantics preserving based cross-modal hashing (MCSPH). MCSPH firstly utilizes the multiple labels of instances and calculates the semantic similarity matrix of raw data through cosine similarity, and secondly uses supervised contrastive loss to make our method have better performance. Thorough experimental evaluations conducted on two benchmark datasets substantiate the superiority of the MCSPH method over prominent baseline approaches.

articleTitle: RM-NET: Rasterizing Markov Signals to Images for Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Statistical machine learning approaches are quite famous for processing Markov signal data. They can model unobserved states and learn certain characteristics particular to a signal with good accuracy. However, with the advent of deep learning, the novice ways of solving a problem has shifted towards this more sophisticated algorithm, which is better, powerful and more accurate. Specifically, deep convolutional neural nets (CNNs) have shown many promising results on images and videos. In this paper we propose how CNN can be applied to a 1D Markov signal using signal rasterization. Rasterization is the process of taking a vector and converting it into a raster image. We start by rasterizing a 1D numeric Markov signal into an image followed by applying CNN to perform two basic tasks: signal classification and error segment localization. We call this process as RM-Net. We demonstrate the performance of our approach using CNN on simulated data bench-marked against statistical models as baseline. We also illustrate the supremacy of our proposed technique on real-word dataset ‘1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 Structural Variants (SV)’ where we try to estimate the location of Copy Number Variant (CNV) in a chromosome. Finally, we conclude using the metrics obtained on both the datasets that our proposed approach is better for classification and error segment localization, shows promising results and has scope for future improvements over traditional statistical machine learning approaches.

articleTitle: Multi-UAV Cooperative Search Method based on Multi-group ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Multi-UAV cooperative flight also plays an important role in artificial intelligence. When multi-UAVs search for targets in cooperative missions, it is particularly important that all UAVs can work together effectively to improve the search efficiency and reduce the search risk. Firstly, this paper expounds the research background and significance of Multi-UAV cooperative target search. This article by using ant colony algorithm, the search problem of single UAV flying target is solved, and then the search problem of Multi-UAV flying target is solved by using multi-group ant colony algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the Multi-UAV cooperative search method improved by multi-group ant colony algorithm is proved by simulation and comparative analysis.

articleTitle: Objective Evaluation Metrics for Spatial Perception of Automotive Audio System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The automotive audio system is considered as a new trend in the field of audio industry. Acoustic environment of cabin is a challenging problem, which makes tuning crucial. Traditionally, tuning has relied on subjective listening by audio engineers, the process of which can last for several months. This study proposes an objective evaluation method for spatial audio in vehicles, which utilizes acoustic measurement and signal processing techniques to evaluate the spatial perception of automotive audio accurately. This method requires minimal number of equipment and costs few measurement time, thus reducing the workload of audio engineers. Subjective experiments have validated that this method effectively reflects subjective auditory experiences.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Computing Offloading Policy for MEC-assisted Power Sensor Network: A D3QN Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
