abstract: With the deep and close integration of massive renewable and controllable terminals into the next generation smart power grid, the amount of data and various applications with different quality requirements will increase greatly, which will be tough challenges for the power sensor network to provide real-time data collecting and processing, global monitoring, and quick response, etc. Meanwhile, due to the limitation in energy supplement and computing capacity, it is a second issue for the sensor network how to work in an energy-efficient way. In this paper, our work sets out to study a reinforcement learning (RL) based computing offloading policy in the mobile edge computing (MEC) assisted power sensor network. By jointly optimizing task scheduling and resource allocation, we propose a new scheme to optimize data latency and energy efficiency. The optimization problem is modeled as a Markov decision process (MDP), and Dueling Double Deep Q Network (D3QN) algorithm is employed to solve this MDP problem. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and its outperformance in reduction of data latency and energy consumption as well as convergence and stability, compared with other benchmarks.

articleTitle: Parallel Multi-objective Multi-type Robot Disassembly Line Balancing Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Remanufacturing of waste products cannot be separated from disassembly. Reasonable disassembly sequence can realize balanced production of disassembly line, increase work efficiency during remanufacturing, reduce capital investment, reduce pollutant emission, improve safety level and increase parts utilization rate. In previous studies, few have considered the balance between profit and the environment. To tackle this problem, the paper proposes an enhanced parallel layout disassembly line model and utilizes an improved multi-objective multi-verse optimization approach to obtain superior solutions. The accuracy of the model and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are validated by comparing the results with those obtained using other algorithms.

articleTitle: The Improved Pedestrian Target Detection and Re-recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Image processing technology can be applied to detect and recognize the specific pedestrian target. To well detect moving pedestrian targets in complex occlusion scenes, the improved pedestrian detection algorithm based on YOLOv5 and re-recognition algorithm based on foreground mask estimation are proposed in this paper. In the improved pedestrian detection algorithm, aiming at interclass occlusion, a new two-branch fusion detection head is designed, the loss function and sample matching strategy are modified, meanwhile the non-maximum suppression algorithm is optimized. Aiming at in-class occlusion, SoftNMS algorithm is introduced to improve the detection capability in occlusion scene. In the modified pedestrian re-recognition algorithm, to enhance the pedestrian re-recognition rate under intricate backgrounds, HRNetV2 network replaces ResNet50 as the backbone network and three loss functions are optimized. Experimental results show that modified algorithms improves the performance of pedestrian target detection and re-recognition in complex occlusion scenes.

articleTitle: An Improved AdaBoost Method in Imbalanced Data Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Learning from imbalanced datasets has recently received increasing research attention. Despite the remarkable results of AdaBoost in balanced situation, the imbalance problem remains to be solved. To address this, this paper proposes a novel method to improve the AdaBoost using a new error factor and a weighted voting parameter for a few classes and weak classifiers. Our method can weaken the dominant role of the majority class in iterative training by improving the classification ability of the minority class. The superiority of the proposed algorithm is finally proved theoretically and practically. Several real-world imbalance datasets in experiments as specific support, and our method outperforms previous algorithms, especially in the F-1 metric.

articleTitle: An IMU Error Correction Method Based on Multithreshold ZV Detection and SRCKF
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the rapid development and widespread application of Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), IMU-based human localization has become critically important in environments lacking Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) signals. Methods such as UWB/WIFI and other anchor-based localization have been employed to enhance the positioning accuracy. However, these methods are susceptible to the environmental interference and increased costs. In contrast, SINS-based localization methods eliminate reliance on the external data. However, this method can suffer from drift errors due to cumulative integration errors. Inertial navigation error correction techniques like Zero Detection Update Technology (ZUPT) provide potential solutions to address drift errors. This paper proposes an error correction method based on the multithreshold zero-velocity detection and Square Root Cubature Kalman Filter (SRCKF) updates. Compared to the single fixed threshold detection, the multi-threshold zero-velocity detection reduces the likelihood of missed zero velocity detection and false alarms, providing accurate time intervals for error correction. Experimental results demonstrate that the SRCKF-based algorithm reduces position deviation to approximately 0.3146 meters, corresponding to an error ratio of1.14%. The proposed method enables cost-effective and accurate pedestrian localization, driving advancements in the field.

articleTitle: A novel policy network with a soft reward strategy for knowledge graph reasoning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Path reasoning over knowledge graph is an important method carried on knowledge graph completion. Recently, there are bright performance on reinforcement learning applications for path reasoning, which range from the initial reinforcement learning framework (Deeppath) to Bayesian reinforcement learning framework (GaussianPath) and so on. It is still being big challenges on the reduction of spurious search trajectories caused by invalid actions and the low probability of reaching positive rewards. Thus, a Gate Policy-Guided Path Reasoning (GPGPR) model framework is proposed for solving the knowledge graph completion. It mainly consists of a policy-guided graph search algorithm and a novel soft reward function. Specifically, The policy-guided graph search algorithm is implemented by a gate policy network with invalid action masking. It can filter spurious search trajectories caused by invalid actions to obtain more suitable action distributions. The novel soft reward function employs target embedding dropout mechanism to determine whether a target entity is dose to the ground truth to make higher positive rewards for obtaining the expected accumulated reward. In this experiments, we select MRR and Hits@N as metrics and conduct extensive contrast experiments between the proposed model and basdine models on open knowledge base datasets.

articleTitle: An efficient multi-view and multi-channel disease risk prediction model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the development of medical information, machine learning are applied on clinical aid to decision-making, for example disease prediction, mortality risk prediction, and so on. For the multi-dimensional, and multi-modality and sequential clinical data, there are being some challenges on feature fusion and representation which would impact the performance of prediction models. In addition, model interpretation attracts more attention in medical AI application field. According to the difference among the contribution from different examination indicators to predict the disease risk, we need consider the relation between indicators and disease as well as the time-dependence of indicators. In this work, we design a Multi-View and Multi-Channel (MVMC) method to construct patient record and propose an ensemble multi-view and multi-channel disease risk prediction model. In this work, we construct visit-view, feature-view and modality-view to represent the patient clinical features. Meanwhile multi-channel data processing mehod is used to extract temporal and spatial characteristics among features. We adopt GRU+CNN and Bi-GRU and transformer in our ensemble models for feature-view, visit-view and modality-view respectively. Attention mechanism is used for computation of correlation coefficient among each view to simulate physician diagnosis process. Experimental results show that our ensemble MVMC model achieves advanced performance in Precision, AUC, Recall and F1-score on the two data sets. Then we give the model interpretation by heatmap.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision-Making in Diabetes Diagnosis: An Exploration of Multi-Granularity Three-Way Decisions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Diabetes, a chronic metabolic disease prevalent in real world, poses challenges due to its complex ambiguity and uncertainty in diagnosis and treatment. To address these issues, this paper proposes an intelligent decision-making framework that combines triangular fuzzy sets (TFSs), multigranularity (MG) three-way decision (TWD) and MABAC (Multi-Attribute Border Approximation Area Comparison). First, granular computing is applied to cope with the uncertainty of diabetes disease data by transforming it into an MG representation. Next, the MG TWD method is utilized to categorize the diagnosis and treatment of the disease into different levels, leading to a comprehensive evaluation and the final diagnosis result. Additionally, TFSs are employed to describe the fuzzy characteristics of diabetes and remedy plans, whereas the MABAC method is used to compare and evaluate different plans, ultimately selecting the optimal treatment strategy. By applying these methods, we effectively address the ambiguity and uncertainty associated with diabetes diagnosis and treatment. The intelligent decision-making framework offers more accurate and reliable diagnosis results, serving as a scientific foundation for doctors to develop personalized treatment plans. Moreover, this study holds significant value in advancing the field of diabetes diagnosis and treatment, offering new ideas and methods to improve the quality of life and health outcomes for diabetes patients.

articleTitle: Selective Attention UNet for Segmenting Liver Tumors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In order to segregate liver tumours in medical imaging applications, a novel architecture called Selective Attention UNet is proposed in this article. The suggested architecture, which is based on the well-known UNet architecture, has a selective attention module that enables the network to concentrate on crucial tasks while suppressing unnecessary ones. Link skipping between the encoder and decoder routes is another element of the design that enables the network to effectively segment data using both low-level and high-level attributes. On the publicly accessible LiTS dataset, we assessed the performance of the suggested architecture and contrasted it with four fundamental models: FCN, UNet, UNet++, and SegNet. The Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.89 a mean IOU of 0.76 obtained in our experiments demonstrates that the suggested architecture beats all baseline models in terms of accuracy and robustness criteria. The project is accessible at: https://github.com/darshan8850/Liver-tumor-Segmentation

articleTitle: PageRank Algorithm Based on Dynamic Damping Factor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The search engine ranking algorithm plays a significant role in enhancing the user experience by effectively ranking search pages. Among various algorithms, the PageRank algorithm has emerged as the dominant choice owing to its simplicity and efficiency. An essential parameter in the PageRank algorithm is the damping factor, which represents the time that random web visitors spend following the hyperlink structure and significantly influences the algorithm’s performance. However, existing methods often set the damping factor empirically, overlooking the relevance of web visitors’ topics. This oversight becomes problematic as users are increasingly exposed to noisy chains and overwhelmed by excessive hyperlinks, leading to a decline in the PageRank algorithm’s performance and a diminished user experience. To tackle this challenge, we propose an adaptive dynamic damping factor based on the web browsing context, enhancing the effectiveness of the optimized PageRank algorithm. Through experimental analysis, we results demonstrate that the dynamic damping coefficient-based PageRank algorithm effectively mitigates the impact of noisy web pages on query results and significantly improves the algorithm’s convergence speed.

articleTitle: Evaluating disease-disease associations based on network representation learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Evaluating disease-disease associations is critical for understanding the complex mechanism of less well-studied disease and facilitating disease diagnosis and therapy. Therefore, people present some methods to explore the potential connection between disease. However, they mostly rely on overlaps between disease-related gene sets or distances within ontological levels, where the diseases are described by discrete or sparse feature vectors failing to capture the latent semantic information of disease. In this study, inspired by the successfully application of network representation in bioinformatics tasks, we propose a novel method to evaluate disease-disease associations by combining network representation learning with best-match average similarity strategy. Our method can capture more semantically rich disease feature vectors and make better use of prior biological knowledge. The experimental results on a public benchmark dataset showed that our method can improve the predictive performance, and the visualization analysis further demonstrate the effectiveness of disease latent features learned by network representation learning.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of deep network-based breast tumor classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, computer-aided diagnosis technology has become one of the important research directions in the field of medicine. Among them, considerable progress has been made in the application of artificial intelligence technology in medical data processing, especially in medical imaging. Currently, breast cancer is one of the most common malignant tumors in women worldwide, accounting for about one-fourth of all malignant tumors, and its incidence has been on the rise in the past decades. If breast cancer can be successfully diagnosed at an early stage, the survival rate of patients can be greatly improved, so early diagnosis and treatment of breast cancer is especially important. However, most of the current diagnostic methods are application-oriented and have not been explored in depth on how to improve the recognition accuracy, so the purpose of this paper is to explore how to improve the accuracy of breast cancer recognition.

articleTitle: Parallel-Path Transformer Network for Time-Domain Monaural Speech Separation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In recent years, speaker-independent, monaural speech separation methods have made great progress with the development of deep neural networks (DNNs). However, in the automotive environment, computational resources are limited and the cockpit sound field environment is more complex. These factors pose significant challenges to the task of speech separation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a parallel-path transformer model. The model employs a parallel processing strategy that combines improved feed-forward networks with transformer modules. It simultaneously applies intra-chunk transformer and inter-chunk transformer to process the input sequences, avoiding the need for implicit modeling of intermediate states. This approach enables the model to perform local and global modeling of the speech signals in a parallel manner, capturing both short and long-term dependencies within the speech sequences. Consequently, the proposed model enhances the system’s modeling performance. Experimental results on the WSJ0-2Mix and WHAM! datasets demonstrate that the proposed model achieves excellent speech separation performance while maintaining smaller model parameters and computational complexity.

articleTitle: Digital Core Reconstruction Method Based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo Algorithm and Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: We propose a digital core reconstruction method that leverages both the Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) model. Traditional 2D to 3D methods often suffer from poor connectivity, resulting in unreasonable skeleton and small pores. To address these issues, we present a 3D reconstruction model trained on real 2D core data, which uses deep convolution and GAN to learn the planar distribution characteristics of 2D images. We employ the Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm to sample and enhance the continuity and variation between neighboring reconstructed layers, leading to a more logically structured three-dimensional pore network. We validate our model using both isotropic and anisotropic porous media, obtaining excellent agreement with actual samples in terms of porosity, two-point correlation function, Minkowski functionals, and visual representation. Compared to using only the Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm, our model yields better results, reducing the generation of isolated skeletons and un-reasonable small pores. Furthermore, our model requires less training sets and less training time on porous media, while maintaining similar generating effects, making it a more cost-effective option.

Author Keywords: the Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm

articleTitle: Application of Multidimensional Mixed Teaching Mode in Diagnostics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Diagnostics holds a pivotal role in the transition from preclinical medicine to clinical medicine, encompassing a robust theoretical foundation and a high demand for practical skills. To meet the contemporary requirements of the field and the advancements in science and technology, it is imperative to redefine the teaching approach in diagnostics. The primary objective should be to cultivate students’ professional competence, ignite their intrinsic motivation to learn, and foster teaching innovation by incorporating engaging techniques. Furthermore, leveraging artificial intelligence and information technology can facilitate course innovation. Within this framework, the present study proposes a multidimensional mixed teaching model. By integrating various teaching methods, fostering innovation, and providing comprehensive practical opportunities, the understanding of novice learners in the diagnostics course can be significantly enhanced, and teaching goals can be efficiently achieved.

articleTitle: Intelligent Modes of Maritime Rights Safeguard Operations and Key Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Under the influence of intelligent technology, unmanned equipment is gradually popularized and applied in combat, and its effectiveness has been tested and verified. Driven by intelligent unmanned equipment, a big difference is bound to be made in the field of maritime operation, and becoming the new force of maritime rights safeguard operation. This paper analyzes the wining mechanism and internal principles of maritime rights safeguard operations under the influence of intelligent technology, probe into the potential intelligent modes of maritime rights safeguard operations, discuss the advantage and disadvantages and the internal relations of these intelligent operation modes, and puts forward some key technologies, analyze the characters of the technology, which will be of some value to defend the maritime rights and related technology development.

articleTitle: Congruity feature extraction across Parkinson’s voice disorder datasets based on formal concept analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Voice disorder is an early symptom of Parkinson’s disease (PD), which makes acoustic analysis be used to evaluate voice performance from the early stage of PD. However, the existence of confounding factors in PD dataset leads to contradictory conclusions in different studies. In order to reduce the influence of confounding factors and improve the stability and generalization ability of acoustic measurement feature, congruity features across datasets (CFAD) based on formal concept analysis (FCA) are proposed in this study. Firstly, the significant features in different datasets are selected by using CART; Then, the formal context between the datasets and the significant features is established based on FCA; Finally, the formal concepts are extracted based on the formal context to obtain the combination of significant features under the different combination of popular datasets, completing the extraction of CFAD and verifying the performance. The results have shown that CFAD have achieved more than 90% of the performance of the original dataset on four datasets. It can be concluded that CFAD provide a reference value for the study of acoustic measurement features in the field of PD, helping to establish a more reliable PD detection model with higher generalization.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Approach Based on Heterogeneous Dense Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In this research, we propose a novel algorithm for fusing visible and infrared images using a heterogeneous dense network and CBAM, generating fused images with more texture details while preserving salient targets. Firstly, the encoder and decoder are constructed based on the heterogeneous dense network to achieve deep feature extraction and reconstruction of the source image. Secondly, to guide network optimization, we design a loss function using the salient target mask. Under the constraint of this loss function, the encoder calculates pixel and gradient losses for background areas and salient target areas, respectively, with the decoder then fusing the features of corresponding areas to reconstruct desired results. Additionally, CBAM is added to the fusion part to process infrared image features by focusing more on salient targets and reducing redundant information introduction. Finally, experiments demonstrate that our algorithm enhances detailed features while preserving target features consistent with human visual characteristics. The proposed algorithm achieves a superior fusion effect.

articleTitle: Robust observer and proximal policy optimization-based VTOL vehicle attitude stabilization research
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In this paper, a robust observer-based proximal policy optimization control method (ROPPO), which combines a robust observer and a proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm in deep reinforcement learning, is studied for the attitude stabilization of vertical take-off and landing vehicles considering elastic vibration and model uncertainty disturbances. Firstly, a robust observer is designed to reconstruct the elastic vibration into easily controlled attitude-added angles and outputs the reconstructed pitch attitude angle and angular velocity. The deep reinforcement learning agent interacts continuously with the environment consisting of the robust observer and dynamics model, and learns based on the feedback from the environment to achieve attitude stabilization during the vehicle's vertical take-off and landing phase. The simulation results show that the designed ROPPO algorithm is more robust and converges faster than the proximal policy optimization (PPO) and the currently used adaptive fuzzy PID algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified on a self-made (Vertical take-off and landing) VTOL vehicle in the real world.

articleTitle: An Alliance Confrontation Model of the UAVs Based on Improved Clustering Algorithm and Artificial Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of decomposing large scale unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) group into small UAV groups and how to make alliance between small UAV groups is beneficial to the combat, a system countermeasure model of swarm UAV attack and defense is proposed. First, based on the characteristics of the small group of the attack and defense UAV, the objective function of the small group alliance of the attack and defense UAV is constructed, and then the improved clustering algorithm and the artificial ant colony algorithm are established respectively to calculate the objective function. Finally, the system confrontation scene is set, and the simulation verification of the model and algorithm is carried out. Through the analysis of simulation data, the validity of the model and algorithm is verified. The model provides an important reference for the decision-making of attack and defense of clustered UAVs.

articleTitle: Research on Orderly Charging Strategy of Electric Vehicles Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The current charging order of electric vehicles is chaotic. There are some shortcomings in disordered charging sequence, such as chaotic charging time, chaotic charging time, uncertain charging power. With the increase of the number of electric vehicles, this disorderly charging method will bring many disorderly load shocks to the power grid, which will pose a great challenge to the normal operation of the power grid. Aiming at the optimal strategy of orderly charging of electric vehicles, this paper proposes an intelligent charging control strategy for electric vehicles is proposed in this paper. The objective function is to minimize the optimal charging start time of each electric vehicle and the total load power of the power system. Considering the maximum load power allowed by the power system, the state of charge (SOC) of the electric vehicle battery and other constraint conditions. a multi-objective optimization model for the centralized charging of electric vehicles is established. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to solve the optimization model, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the model are proved by the calculation results of MATLAB software. The influence of different values of charging systems in different states on the optimization results are analyzed, and relevant suggestions are given accordingly.

articleTitle: A path transmission algorithm for the mobile Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks based on MPTCP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) is an interactive wireless network based on vehicle location, speed, route and other information. The traditional VANETs generally uses single path for data transmission. However, there is a communication interruption issue with this transmission method during the switching process, which will seriously affect the quality of service of the vehicle network. In order to solve the problem of unstable data transmission in the VANETs, some scholars put forward the idea use multi-path Transmission Control Protocol (MPTCP) in VANETs. However, researchers often neglect some potential influencing factors when constructing multi-path vehicle network transmission algorithm. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a path management algorithm for vehicle networking based on path characteristics and signal characteristics(PCSC). The algorithm mainly includes three functional modules, which are distance identification module, communication path evaluation module and communication path selection module. In order to verify the performance of the algorithm, we designed a simulation experiment of vehicle movement in the software Mininet-WiFi. The results show that PCSC algorithm has higher flexibility in path selection than traditional MPTCP algorithm and existing path transmission algorithm. And PCSC algorithm performs better in the overall data transmission.

articleTitle: Simple and Efficient Knowledge Graph Attention Network for Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Existing methods for modeling recommendation systems based on knowledge graphs include embedding-based, pathbased, and propagation-based methods. The embedding-based approach is flexible but more suitable for intra-graph applications, the path-based approach can model complex relationships but has a high computational cost, and the propagation-based approach considers global information but may introduce noise. This study proposed a simple and efficient model, called SEKGAT, which comprehensive the ideology of path-based and propagation approach to personalized recommendation by aggregating the user preferences through graph attention mechanism and fusing multiple feature representations on the knowledge graph into item features through pooling aggregators. Experimental results for the CTR prediction and Top-K recommendation tasks on three datasets of real-world scenarios show that our model approach is competitive.

articleTitle: Research on Ballistic Planning Method Based on Improved DDPG Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Aiming at the ballistic planning problem given the target position indication under the condition of satisfying the missile capability boundary and process constraints, an improved deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm is proposed. This method solves the problems of the traditional trajectory planning method, such as strong dependence on model, low adaptability to environment and lack of real-time performance. The agent is firstly trained by this algorithm at the initial stage in a simple environment through a guided training based on the slow training speed of deep neural network, and then the generated strategy is adopted as an initial strategy for retraining. In the process, the sampling strategy of experience-first playback is applied to the gradient algorithm of deep deterministic strategy, and the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) noise model is employed for increasing the exploration ability of the agent. Then, this work develops a comprehensive simulation model according to an actual environment, where an improved DDPG method is thus introduced into the ballistic planning field by combining with performance indicators for planning and the trajectory can also meet the constraints. In order to verify the effectiveness of this method, the Gaussian pseudo-spectrum method is also used to compare with the proposed method in this paper. The simulation results show that the ballistic planning time of this improved algorithm is only within 10ms, which is about 8 times shorter than that of Gaussian pseudo-spectrum method. The corresponding ballistics that satisfy the constraints can be quickly generated, which has a good convergence and robustness, and is also suitable for solving online ballistic planning problems.

articleTitle: Research on Source - Grid Planning And Vulnerability Assessment of Low Carbon Station Area Based on Improved DEAHP Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the continuous development of the country “s new power system with new energy as the main body, the current low-carbon station area laclss efficient control means for multi-energy applications, and it is urgent to improve the station area ’s perception and control capabilities for photovoltaic power generation systems and wind power generation systems. When the power grid is connected to renewable energy, due to its intermittent and random operation characteristics, unstable output characteristics and uncontrollable source power, the power grid will inevitably have some unpredictable fragile characteristics in structure and operation. In this paper, a vulnerability assessment method with uncertainty measure is proposed by establishing a multi-scenario planning model of the system and evaluating the vulnerability of power grid components from multiple perspectives. Through the verification of simulation data, this method can effectively identify the weak nodes and branches in the power grid of low-carbon districts, and can provide power grid security early waruing information for operation analysts and dispatchers.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Grid Risk Assessment and optimization for High Proportion Distributed Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the wide access of a variety of distributed energy sources in China’s low-carbon station area, it is inevitable to have a negative impact on the grid loss, power quality and other aspects of the distribution grid, and the current low carbon station area lacks effective control means for multi-energy applications. Firstly, this paper analyzes the operation characteristics of the distribution grid with multiple power supplies, and establishes a coordinated optimization model of distributed power supply and energy storage based on cluster division, so as to minimize the overall loss of the distribution grid system. Secondly, under the condition that the optimization result is not inferior to the preset value, the fluctuation interval of the uncertainty variable is maximized, so as to avoid the influence of uncertainty on the solution result to the maximum extent. Finally, the risk avoidance optimization model is established, and the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the optimization model. The method described in this paper and the simulation example have reference significance for the optimization of distribution grid with high proportion of distributed energy.

articleTitle: Reliable Region Mining for Weakly Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Class Activation Map (CAM) is a common tool to address image-level weakly supervised image segmentation (WSIS) tasks, which mainly extract the most discriminative regions as pseudo-labels for the segmentation networks. However, it is difficult to accurately locate the salient regions since similar image intensities and low-contrast in the medical image field. In our work, we put in a novel WSIS model to exploit visual detail features to enhance the semantic expression ability of the object target. The model consists of two branches: the classification branch and the segmented branch. The classification branch includes two subbranches: local classification and global classification. Differing from existing local-global models, we employ expansion convolution to increase the receptive field for the global classification branch, while designing an affinity-aware module in the local network to obtain the original context information of the local image. The global and local classification branches work together to provide pseudo-labels for the segmentation branch. The experimental results show that our model outperforms other state-of-the-art methods with a DSC of 46.7% on the publicly available MSD dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Multidimensional Causal Model of Environment in Macao Cotai City Ecological Reserve
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: (1) Background: The Macao Cotai City Ecological Reserve in China’s Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area is essential for biodiversity, environmental enhancement, and sustainable growth. However, varying weather and intricate environmental issues complicate its oversight. A thorough environmental model, addressing all influential factors, is crucial. (2) Methods: This study employs the Bayesian network (BN) modeling technique to develop a multidimensional causal model for the environment of the Macao Cotai City Ecological Reserve. By utilizing environmental models, the interactions among the three sub-networks: meteorology, air quality, and water quality are analyzed. This facilitates the qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the cause-and-effect relationships between pollutants and the factors influencing such pollutants. Through these models, the aim is to collaboratively predict pollutant concentrations, facilitating informed environmental decision-making and management. (3) Results: The multidimensional causal model designed for the Macao Cotai City Ecological Reserve environment is adept at capturing intricate nonlinear relationships. It is proficient in managing uncertainty, offers high interpretability, and ensures efficient computations. (4) Conclusions: This study offers insights into the environmental systems of Macao Cotai City Ecological Reserve, supporting its management and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Intention Recognition Trustworthiness Measurement using a Spatiotemporal Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The current intent recognition method has insufficient generalization ability, and the evaluation of confidence level of intent recognition is the key to its popularization and application in the high-reliability military and civilian fields. The spatiotemporal Knowledge Graph can uniformly represent and efficiently organize entities containing spatial location information and temporal information. Battlefield situational objectives and their relationships can be abstracted as a triple composed of two specific types of spatiotemporal entities and combat intent relationships. Using typical confrontation scene data to train neural networks, and fusing the confidence levels of the entity and Knowledge Graph, the confidence level evaluation results of the intent triple for the existing spatiotemporal knowledge base are calculated. The simulation test results show that the method can effectively evaluate the confidence level of the intent recognition results, and the accuracy rate is improved compared with the current mainstream methods. This method breaks the "closure" assumption of the Knowledge Graph update and completion algorithm from the algorithm idea level, and completes the last link in the popularization and application of the intent recognition method

articleTitle: An Air-Sea Identification and Detection Confrontation Evolutionary Game Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: An evolutionary game model of air-to-sea identification and detection confrontation is proposed in order to solve the problem of how to choose the attack and defense strategies in the identification and detection stages. First, the mathematical model of an air-to-sea attack strategy in identification and detection stages is established, and then the mathematical model of ship defense strategy in identification and detection stages is established. On this basis, the air-to-sea identification and detection revenue function is constructed, and then the corresponding evolutionary game model of air-to-sea identification and detection is established. An algorithm is proposed to solve the air-to-sea identification and detection confrontation evolutionary game model by replicating the dynamic equation. The resultant simulation shows that: For the jamming party and the anti-jamming party, faced the prerequisite of not knowing what jamming mode the other party will take, the anti-jamming party’s choice of frequency agility and the jamming party’s adoption of frequency-sweeping jamming can be the optimal strategies irrespective of the enemy’s choice. The simulation results verify the validity of the game model, which can provide better decision support for the commander’s rational decisions.

articleTitle: Circular Disassembly Lines for Green Manufacturing and Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: A new form of disassembly line layout has been proposed, known as the circular disassembly line. This layout utilizes circular automation equipment to disassemble various products. The circular shape allows products to rotate throughout the disassembly process, thereby enhancing efficiency and flexibility. In addition, to facilitate product rotation, the equipment employs an embedded turntable structure. By utilizing a rotating platform, a turntable, or other rotating devices, products can maintain an appropriate disassembly angle, ensuring consistency and quality control throughout the entire process. Through cyclic allocation, tasks are quickly assigned to idle workstations for disassembly. This achieves workload balancing and improves the utilization rate of workstations to meet the ever-changing disassembly demands. As a result, labor costs are reduced, and consistency and quality control in the disassembly process are enhanced. In summary, compared to traditional disassembly lines, the Circular Disassembly Line offers multiple advantages, including improved efficiency, flexibility, accuracy, and quality control, as well as reduced operational costs and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Proactive Production Forecasting to Support Offshore Wind Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: This research explores a proactive production forecasting methodology to support the current offshore wind development in the U.S., highlighting the effectiveness of utilizing a well-trained long short-term memory (LSTM) machine learning model, which robustly captures intricate temporal patterns in historical wind speed trends, wind turbine power curves, forecasted offshore wind speeds, and wind turbine configuration parameters, thus offering a reliable foundation for effective power production predictions. Due to the underdevelopment of offshore wind in the U.S. and the lack of access to true offshore wind farm operational data, this study builds, trains, and tests a generalized model on four existing land-based operational wind farms, and then deploys the model on a New Jersey offshore wind farm that is now under development. Equipped with such a proactive production prediction tool, offshore wind developers and operators could pursue alternative profitable opportunities in the ISO/RTOs’ wholesale electricity markets when state funding for renewable purchases, such as Offshore Renewable Energy Credits (ORECs) or power purchase agreements (PPAs), is not available. Accurate production forecasting can mitigate potential penalties for offshore wind power producers (WPPs) due to over and/or under commitment in the forward wholesale electricity markets and prove them to be as competitive in the markets as those traditionally predictable non-renewable resources.

articleTitle: Three-Way Causal Attribute Partial Order Structure Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: As an emerging concept cognitive learning model, partial order formal structure analysis (POFSA) has been widely used in the field of knowledge processing. In this paper, we propose a method named three-way causal attribute partial order structure (3WCAPOS) to evolve the POFSA from set coverage to causal coverage in order to increase the interpretability and classification performance of the model. First, the concept of causal factor (CF) is proposed to evaluate the causal correlation between attributes and decision attributes in the formal decision context. Then, combining CF with attribute partial order structure, the concept of causal attribute partial order structure is defined and makes set coverage evolve into causal coverage. Finally, combined with the idea of three-way decision, 3WCAPOS is formed, which makes the purity of nodes in the structure clearer and the changes between levels more obviously. In addition, experiments are carried out from the classification ability and the interpretability of the structure through six datasets. Through these experiments, it is concluded the accuracy of 3WCAPOS is improved by 1%-9% compared with classification and regression tree, and more interpretable and the processing of knowledge is more reasonable compared with attribute partial order structure.

articleTitle: A Method for Pilot Acceptability Evaluation of Airborne Collision Avoidance System Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Compared with the existing Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance System (TCAS), the development of the new system, Airborne Collision Avoidance System X (ACAS X), uses a model-based optimization method to improve airspace safety and operational efficiency. However, due to the opacity of the model-based optimization method in the process of automatically generating logic, the resolution advisory issued by ACAS X are often misunderstood or difficult for pilots to accept. In this paper, first we introduce the development process of ACAS X, and then analyze the natural shortcomings of ACAS X and the evaluation metrics for ACAS X optimization from the perspective of human factors engineering. Finally, we propose a method for evaluating the pilot acceptability of collision avoidance system based on Genetic Algorithm (GA). This method is used to find high collision risk encounters where ACAS X tends to issue advisories that are not conducive to the pilot's acceptance, so as to evaluate the pilot's acceptability of the collision avoidance system. The final simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Minimum Error Entropy High-Order Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The conventional extended Kalman filter(EKF) is proposed under the criterion of minimum mean square error(MMSE) and omits high-order information. This leads to poor estimation of the EKF in non-Gaussian and strongly nonlinear systems. In this paper, for a class of nonlinear non-Gaussian systems in polynomial form, Pseudo-linearizing the system while preserving the high-order information, a new filter is proposed based on the minimum error entropy(MEE) criterion called the minimum error entropy high-order extended Kalman filter (MEE-HEKF). In the MEE-HEKF algorithm, the state estimation problem is transformed into a recursive solution problem in the form of a Kalman filter by a fixed-point iterative approach based on the MEE cost function. The proposed algorithm has better robustness under strong nonlinearity and non-Gaussian noise. Finally, the effectiveness of the new algorithm is illustrated by an example.

articleTitle: Distributed Factory Disassembly Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Due to the swift progress in transportation and communication technologies and the globalization strategy layout of enterprises, the various factories of enterprises are being distributed all over the world and are collaborating through Internet networks to share operation information, forming an off-site distributed multi-factory working environment. A distributed factory disassembly scheduling problem is proposed in this paper, which is a comprehensive scheduling problem considering disassembly and allocation. The problem primarily consists of two stages: the disassembly stage and the allocation stage. In the distributed factory disassembly scheduling problem, several factors need to be considered, such as the work efficiency, work time, and equipment utilization of each factory. Therefore, the difficulty of this problem is to optimize a series of problems such as task and workstation allocation within the disassembly factory and to optimize the selection of disassembly and manufacturing factories. In general, the distributed factory has the advantages of higher flexibility, lower risk, a more optimized supply chain, and higher efficiency compared to the traditional single factory. By effectively solving this problem, companies can reduce disassembly costs, improve disassembly efficiency, and optimize resource utilization, which is of great importance to them.

articleTitle: Bayesian network parameter learning with constraint balance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) is a method for data modeling in artificial intelligence, which is intended to pursue the best fit of data and parameters. When the training data are insufficient, the model parameters that rely only on MLE for learning are unreliable. Similarly, for Bayesian networks (BNs), a crucial tool for uncertainty representation, the problem of low accuracy of parameter learning caused by insufficient data is also faced. Due to their clear structure and interpretability, BN can effectively fuse the parameter constraints transformed from prior knowledge to improve learning accuracy using the maximum a posteriori estimation (MAP). However, balancing data and constraints evolves into a new concern. With too much reliance on constraints, the data loses meaning, and the obtained prior knowledge can not be disregarded. Therefore, this paper proposes a constraint-balanced maximum a posteriori estimation method, which performs parameter learning by balancing the roles played by data and constraints in the parameter learning process. Through experiments, the proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy of parameter learning.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Adjustment Strategy of Flexible Load in Low-Carbon Regional Based on Parameter Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the ‘carbon peak, carbon neutralization’ construction project, the low carbon station area power supply system has become an important part of the new power system. Firstly, the dynamic mechanical model of plant load change in typical low-carbon industrial parks is established by using the centralized humidifier of the park as the flexible load, and it is verified that the first-order system can better describe the dynamic process. Secondly, the auto-regressive model with additional input is used for system identification, and the first-order model is obtained by order reduction. Thirdly, the transfer function of the model system is reduced to a differential equation by using the inverse Laplace transform, and the analytical solution of the differential equation is obtained. The pre-start time is determined according to the expected humidity and the target time. Finally, for the case beyond the range of application, the model parameters can be re-identified. The results show that this method can accurately and conveniently determine the adaptive pre-start time of air humidification equipment, and has a wide range of application scope, which is an efficient method. The application of this method is not limited to air humidification equipment, and can be used for public load in low-carbon station areas.

articleTitle: FALLNET: A Deep Learning Model for Fall Detection using improved CNN-Attention-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: As the aging population continues to grow, fall detection has become a key issue in public health and healthcare. To address the problem of low accuracy and poor real-time performance of fall detection algorithms in real scenarios, an improved fall detection model, FALLNET, is proposed. First, an improved YOLOv7-X-pose algorithm is used to quickly extract multiple human body keypoints in the multi-person keypoint extraction module. Second, the classic CNN_Attention_LSTM model is improved in the dangerous action recognition module by adding an LSTM layer to better capture the important features of the input sequence and improve the model’s prediction accuracy. In addition, a Kalman filter target tracking algorithm is also added to the system to ensure the extraction algorithm’s extraction order and accuracy. The improved model performs well in all tasks and can efficiently and accurately identify falling actions in practical scenarios. These results demonstrate that our model has good practicality and application prospects and is expected to provide reliable technical support for fall warning and elderly health management.

articleTitle: Multi-Granulation Intuitionistic Fuzzy Rough Sets Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Granular computing is a multidisciplinary field that focuses on information processing models and their granular structure. However, there is still a lack of research on the construction of granularity for intuitionistic fuzzy information systems. In this paper, we propose two methods that utilize principal component analysis theory to create granularity structures for intuitionistic fuzzy systems. These approaches lead to the formation of a multi-granulation intuitionistic space and the construction of multi-granularity intuitionistic fuzzy rough set approximations. By using methods of this paper, we can decrease data redundancy for a more streamlined process. The experimental results indicate that our methods can improve the efficiency of information granulation.

articleTitle: A Distributed Message Queuing System Based On Hbase-like K-v Databases
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Message queues, as a low-latency, high-concurrency, and easily accessible data processing middleware, can improve the reliability and efficiency of data processing, and have become an indispensable part of large data and computing systems. For some users, the demand for data security is more prominent, and this article provides a message queue implementation method based on an hbase-like key-value database, which uses the database as a foundation to implement a distributed message queue that can freely control consumer progress and ensure temporal consistency. The safety and performance of this method are equivalent to that of the db components used, and different security levels of databases can be flexibly used as the basic component. In terms of the read-write mechanism of the message, this article has also designed it in detail to achieve optimal performance.

articleTitle: Vibration-based structural health monitoring via deep learning techniques: A review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The vibration signal is closely related to abnormal states, which is an effective diagnostic tool in structural health monitoring (SHM) fields. Deep learning methods have got remarkable success in the detection of damage through vibration signals. This paper presents a systematic review of deep learning methods for SHM that utilizes vibration signal data from different model perspective. In recent years, there has been a tremendous increase in the number of research involving deep learning for vibration-based structural health monitoring. The accuracy of such works is equivalent to that of traditional machine learning approaches, and a better result could be achieved by integrating multiple approaches. Furthermore, we found that transfer learning methods yield the promising results when limited data is utilized to train the model. This paper provides a comprehensive review of existing deep learning research in SHM using vibration signal data from multiple perspectives and fulfills the gap that existing reviews lack in the discussion of transfer learning for SHM by presenting the highlights of the transfer learning. Finally, we summarize the contents of the paper and analyze the challenges of existing research to make recommendations for future work.

articleTitle: VIKOR decision making method based on multi-granularity hesitant fuzzy linguistic term sets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: In the existing multi-attribute decision making researches, most of the hesitant fuzzy linguistic multi-attribute decision making methods assume the decision makers use the linguistic term set under the same granularity to express their linguistic evaluation informations. However, in actual decision making, due to different cultural and educational backgrounds, decision makers may use different sets of linguistic terms at different granularities, which leads to the mismatch of decision information and inaccuracy of decision results. To address this problem, this paper proposes VIKOR decision making method based on multi-granularity hesitant furzy linguistic term sets, which consider both the overall benefits of the group and the regret values of individuals to select the optimal solution. Specifically, a VIKOR decision making method based on the multi-granularity hesitant fuzzy linguistic term set is first proposed, which employs to convert the multi-granularity hesitant fuzzy linguistic term set of each decision maker to the same granularity for aggregation, and obtains the corresponding membership level linguistic term set. Secondly, using the VIKOR method, the positive and negative ideal solutions are determined, and all alternatives are ranked based on their proximity to the positive ideal solution. This ranking facilitates the selection of the optimal solution. Secondly, combined with the VIKOR method, the positive and negative ideal solutions are determined, and all alternatives are ranked in order of merit according to the magnitude of the closeness of the preference value setting of each alternative to the positive ideal solution, so as to achieve the selection of the optimal solution. Finally, an arithmetic example is used to prove the accuracy, rationality and feasibility of the method, and the stability of the proposed method is further illustrated by experimentally analyzing the decision mechanism coefficients.

articleTitle: A GAN-based Relative Radiometric Correction Model of Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: While there are many traditional methods for radiometric correction of multitemporal remote sensing images, deep learning methods are quite rare. Recently it has witnessed a rapid development of computer vision, many style transfer and domain transfer methods have given us great inspiration. However, traditional methods have problem in achieving uniform effect of radiometric correction, while style transfer methods struggle to realize control of local areas and transfer degree, especially when dealing with complicated remote sensing data. Thus, a generative adversarial network (GAN)-based relative radiometric correction method combined with deep style transfer (NormGAN) is proposed. A cycle-consistent structure is applied for bi-directional domain transfer of non-corresponding regions. VGG19 network is used to obtain feature map for the calculation of content loss and style loss. Meanwhile, rough masks of landcover enable transfer within each class and weight matrix is put forward to control transfer degree. Our results indicate that the proposed NormGAN is capable and effective, which has much superiority over other methods.

articleTitle: Recognition of Pick Wear State Based on Deep LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: Picks are the vital components used in mining machinery for cutting coal-rock mass, and their wear state significantly influence cutting efficiency during the cutting process. Currently, manual experience serves as the primary basis for replacing worn-out picks in most coal mines. However, to improve efficiency, picks are often replaced collectively, resulting in premature replacement of a considerable number of picks that have not reached their expected lifespan, which leads to substantial economic wastage. In this study, real pick replacement data from H coal mine in China is leveraged that classify the wear state of picks into four categories: new picks, slight wear, moderate wear, and severe wear. Due to the purpose of identify picks wear state, a method based on wavelet packet decomposition of the vibration signals generated by cutting drums when cutting coal-rock is proposed. The method utilizes feature vectors composed of the standard deviation of decomposed wavelet packet coefficients and establishes a identification model based on deep Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks using the MATLAB platform. The analysis reveals that the deep LSTM network outperforms the single-layer LSTM neural network in capturing the nonlinear variation characteristics of the data. Moreover, the deep learning model achieves more accurate recognition results compared to the basic Back-Propagation (BP) network. This method presents a novel approach to realize intelligent recognition of the pick wear state and to implement an optimal pick replacement strategy.

articleTitle: Containerized ICT Platform supporting Interoperable Services for Electric Mobility
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Cyber-Physical Social Intelligence (ICCSI)
abstract: The recent need of substituting the use of conventional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles with new generation vehicles such as electric vehicles (EVs) to preserve the environment and the air quality especially in urban context is a hot topic worldwide. In Europe, there are several ongoing initiatives and research-innovation projects aiming at improving the EV technology and facilitating the charging and driving of such vehicles. In the context of eCharge4Drivers EU project, this paper proposes a containerized Information Communication Technology (ICT) platform architecture to facilitate the connection of the key electromobility actors, to data storage and exchange and to implement enhanced services. Furthermore, the proposed architecture is designed to allow interoperability through the Hubject eRoaming platform.
